descriptions.d19f_set_panel_mode_802b68f4: Switches a list panel to a new mode unless unchanged or globally locked: notifies the base subobject at +28, then on entering mode 1 with a resource computes a clamped display duration from the list size (step at least 10), activates the list or releases it and the global lock when the duration is zero, and plays the enter text; otherwise clears the duration, resets, deactivates the list and plays the leave text; finally forwards the mode to the optional property. Field names describe observed use only.
